about_the_game:
This is a 4K wallpaper pack for "The Grey Dream". The pack includes 35 high-quality wallpapers created in different themes and outfits.

To access the wallpapers:

Click Extras in the main menu, then go to Rewards->Wallpapers 

To access the 4k versions in-game, click the 4K button in the Wallpaper screens

If you want direct access to the wallpapers:

  • Right-click on The Grey Dream in your Steam library.

  • Select Properties.

  • Go to the Installed Files tab.

  • Click Browse.

  • Open the Wallpapers folder.

content_descriptors.notes: The Wallpapers in this DLC depict partial and full nudity.
